limitations: This generates operand identities for new rough drafts; it does not rewrite existing drafts, sessions, history, immutable snapshots or compiler objects.
The normal checker must verify the compiler's actual object format, symbol/relocation inventory and every native placement.
Allocation extents, cross-function data identity and ownership, types, ABI, runtime values and semantics remain independently reviewable requirements.
No function match, game-source promotion or complete game build is claimed.
No shared rule, new ABI/type/initializer, compiler flag, search-budget change or fixed-SDA retargeting is introduced.
